documents.text: As the crisp Helsinki air whipped through the streets, Rory Patterson stepped off the bus and onto the snow-dusted pavement. The Northern Irishman had grown accustomed to the Finnish capital's chill, but it still caught him off guard every now and then. He zipped up his jacket, emblazoned with the crest of his new club, HJK Helsinki, and made his way to the team's training facility. Rory's thoughts drifted back to the conversation he'd had with his agent, Markku, a few weeks prior. "You're a natural fit for the Finnish league, Rory," Markku had said, his thick accent dripping with conviction. "And who knows, maybe even a call-up to the national team?" Rory had laughed it off at the time, but now, as he gazed out at the frozen landscape, the idea didn't seem so far-fetched. As he entered the training complex, Rory was greeted by the familiar sight of his teammates, their faces a mix of Finnish and international players. He exchanged nods and hellos, his Finnish still a work in progress, but getting better with each passing day. Coach Kanerva, a gruff but fair man, was already pacing the sidelines, barking instructions at the players. Rory took his place alongside the others, his eyes scanning the field as they began to run through drills. He felt a tap on his shoulder, and turned to see Teemu Pukki, the Finnish striker, grinning at him. "Hei, Rory! You're looking sharp today. Maybe you'll get the call soon, eh?" Rory smiled, feeling a flutter in his chest. The call. The national team. It was a tantalizing prospect, one that he couldn't help but entertain as he worked through the training session. As the sun began to set over Helsinki, casting a golden glow over the frozen landscape, Rory couldn't shake the feeling that his future was unfolding before him, like the pages of a book waiting to be written.
